title: Hall's books presented to Pope Benedict, who sent a thank-you note
summary: Charles Hall's wife tells of Hall's books presented to Pope Benedict, who sent a thank-you note, about c. 2005-2006 at Rome, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I took the first three books as a presentation for Pope Benedict

plain: Charles Hall is a man who says he spent years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada, and he wrote books about it. His wife says that around 2005 or 2006 she took his first three books to Rome as a gift for Pope Benedict. She tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the Pope sent a thank-you note, which is reproduced in Hall's fourth book.
